Root.description:
A container for grouping a set of controls, such as buttons, toggle groups, or menus.
Renders a `<div>` element.

props.name: loopFocus
props.description: If `true`, using keyboard navigation will wrap focus to the other end of the toolbar once the end is reached.

props.name: orientation
props.description: The orientation of the toolbar.

props.name: class
props.description:
CSS class applied to the element, or a function that
returns a class based on the component's state.

props.name: style
props.description:
Style applied to the element, or a function that
returns a style object based on the component's state.

props.name: render
props.description: Replace the default element with a tag name, component, or render function.

dataAttributes.name: data-orientation
dataAttributes.description: Indicates the orientation of the toolbar.

dataAttributes.name: data-disabled
dataAttributes.description: Present when the toolbar is disabled.

additionalTypes.name: Root.State
Root.ItemMetadata
additionalTypes.source: type ToolbarRootItemMetadata = { disabled: boolean; focusableWhenDisabled: boolean };

Input.description:
A native input element that integrates with Toolbar keyboard navigation.
Renders an `<input>` element.

props.name: focusableWhenDisabled
props.description: When `true` the item remains focusable when disabled.

props.name: disabled
props.description: When `true` the item is disabled.

props.name: class
props.description:
CSS class applied to the element, or a function that
returns a class based on the component's state.

props.name: style
props.description:
Style applied to the element, or a function that
returns a style object based on the component's state.

props.name: render
props.description: Replace the default element with a tag name, component, or render function.

dataAttributes.name: data-orientation
dataAttributes.description: Indicates the orientation of the toolbar.

dataAttributes.name: data-disabled
dataAttributes.description: Present when the input is disabled.

dataAttributes.name: data-focusable
dataAttributes.description: Present when the input remains focusable when disabled.

additionalTypes.name: Input.State

Group.description:
Groups several toolbar items or toggles.
Renders a `<div>` element.

props.description: When `true` all toolbar items in the group are disabled.

props.name: style

props.name: render

Separator.description:
A separator element accessible to screen readers.
Renders a `<div>` element.

props.name: orientation
props.description:
The orientation of the separator. Defaults to the opposite of the toolbar's
orientation, so a horizontal toolbar renders vertical separators.

props.name: class
props.description:
CSS class applied to the element, or a function that
returns a class based on the component's state.

props.name: style
props.description:
Style applied to the element, or a function that
returns a style object based on the component's state.

props.name: render
props.description: Replace the default element with a tag name, component, or render function.

dataAttributes.name: data-orientation
dataAttributes.description: Indicates the orientation of the separator, which is perpendicular to the toolbar.

additionalTypes.name: Separator.State

Button.description:
A button that can be used as-is or as a trigger for other components.
Renders a `<button>` element.

props.name: focusableWhenDisabled
props.description: When `true` the item remains focusable when disabled.

props.name: nativeButton
props.description:
Whether the component renders a native `<button>` element when replacing it
via the `render` prop.
Set to `false` if the rendered element is not a button (for example, `<div>`).

props.name: disabled
props.description: When `true` the item is disabled.

props.name: class
props.description:
CSS class applied to the element, or a function that

props.name: style
props.description:
Style applied to the element, or a function that
returns a style object based on the component's state.

props.name: render
props.description: Replace the default element with a tag name, component, or render function.

dataAttributes.name: data-orientation
dataAttributes.description: Indicates the orientation of the toolbar.

dataAttributes.name: data-disabled
dataAttributes.description: Present when the button is disabled.

dataAttributes.name: data-focusable
dataAttributes.description: Present when the button remains focusable when disabled.

additionalTypes.name: Button.State
